verdict.rationale: The Calendar API documents some first-party operations that act on many items at once: a clear operation that deletes all events on the primary calendar, and a free/busy query across a set of calendars. There is no evidence of general bulk create, update or delete across arbitrary selections of events, so bulk support is narrow. Missing for 10: general batch request support, bulk edit/update of selected events, bulk create/import via API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: This operation deletes all events associated with the primary calendar of an account.
Returns free/busy information for a set of calendars.
